# Underwriting Memo: Varnley Grill Holdings

**Risk summary**

Varnley Grill Holdings operates a full-service restaurant with table seating and bar service (under 30% of sales) across four locations in Texas. Total insured value is $6,770,000 with three locations in San Antonio and one in Dallas. The broker is Pellivane Insurance Group (Core) with a fit score of 78.3.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **IN** appetite per **AG-001** (REST class is target, limit $12M TIV per account). The account falls within the $12M threshold and qualifies as a full-service restaurant. Territory is acceptable under **AG-014** (Central inland locations approved). No referral triggers identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 4 total claims with $214,000 incurred. Notable activity in 2021 (1 slip and fall, $40,600 incurred) and 2024 (3 claims including customer injury, $173,400 incurred). Years 2022, 2023, and 2025 were claim-free. All claims are closed.

**Exposure and concentration**

All locations are non-coastal (201-432 km from coast). Portfolio concentration is elevated with $56.8M existing TIV within 25km of San Antonio locations and $55.4M near Dallas location.

**Recommendation**

Suggest proceeding with quote development. Request details on 2024 customer injury claim and current safety protocols before binding.
